name: stat-card
title: Stat card
description: A dashboard tile: a metric, its change against the previous period in words and colour, and a sparkline.

StatCardChange.description: The change as a small Badge: an arrow (a dash when flat) and the value, green when it moved the good way, red when not, grey when flat (`data-tone`). Screen readers get it in words. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

props.name: period
props.description: Read with the change ("up 12% vs last week"); not shown. The card shows it in its label row.

StatCardSparkline.description: The sparkline alone: the line and its gradient, no axes. The drawing is hidden; a sentence sums it up ("Upward trend over 12 points, from 980 to 1,284"). Interactive, it is one tab stop: focus picks the last point, ← → move along them, a pointer picks the nearest. The drawing keeps time running left to right in right-to-left pages too, as the Line chart does, so → is always the next point. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: data
props.description: The values, oldest first. Fewer than two draw nothing.

props.name: labels
props.description: The tooltip's title per point ("Week 3"). Without it the tooltip shows the value alone.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes a value in the tooltip, the live region and the summary. Default: `dateLocale`.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Index of the point shown as picked (state sheets, docs).

props.name: interactive
props.description: A tab stop whose arrow keys move along the points, with a tooltip on hover. Default true.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the points' group: "Signups, 12 points".

props.name: summaryId
props.description: The id of its text summary, for an element to be described by it (a card's link).

StatCard.description: The stat tile. See the block comment above for the anatomy, states and keys. Other props, `ref` included, go to the root `div`.

props.name: label
props.description: What is measured: "Signups".

props.name: value
props.description: The value. A number goes through `format`; a string shows as given; `null` shows "—" (read "No data").

props.name: format
props.description: Writes a number value, and the sparkline's points ("38 €"). Default: the number in `dateLocale`.

props.name: change
props.description: The change against the previous period. Left out or `null` (no previous period): no badge, no period.

props.name: sparkline
props.description: The values for the sparkline, oldest first. Fewer than two draw nothing.

props.name: sparklineLabels
props.description: The tooltip's title per sparkline point ("Week 3").

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card one link.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeletons at the loaded card's height. Give `sparkline` (even `[]`) to keep its row.

props.name: error
props.description: Shows the reason in place of the value and sparkline; `true` says "Couldn't load".

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Adds Retry to the error.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the content; a link loses its `href`, the sparkline its tab stop.

props.name: countUp
props.description: Counts a number up the first time it appears. Default true; never under reduced motion.
